meta.name: huggingface-tokenizers
meta.description: Fast tokenizers optimized for research and production. Rust-based implementation tokenizes 1GB in <20 seconds. Supports BPE, WordPiece, and Unigram algorithms. Train custom vocabularies, track alignments, handle padding/truncation. Integrates seamlessly with transformers. Use when you need high-performance tokenization or custom tokenizer training.

copy.tagline: 用高性能分词器处理文本数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速分词或训练自定义词表
copy.tagline_en: Process text data with high-performance tokenizers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need fast tokenization or custom vocabulary training

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以快速对文本进行分词（tokenize），支持 BPE、WordPiece、Unigram 三种算法，还能训练自定义词表、跟踪对齐位置、处理填充和截断。
howto.when: 当你需要高性能分词（如处理大文本）或训练自定义分词器时触发。

say.text: 用 BPE 算法训练一个 3 万词表的分词器。
say.note: Claude 会生成训练代码并执行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can quickly tokenize text using BPE, WordPiece, or Unigram algorithms, train custom vocabularies, track alignment positions, and handle padding/truncation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need high-performance tokenization (e.g., processing large text) or training a custom tokenizer.

say_en.text: Train a BPE tokenizer with a vocabulary size of 30,000.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and run training code.

say_en.text: Load the bert-base-uncased tokenizer and encode 'Hello world'.
say_en.note: Claude will output tokens and IDs.
